name: vision_pose
title: Top-down keypoint estimation: affine person crops, Gaussian heatmap targets, a weighted per-joint MSE and the flip test
origin: domain-vision round 2: the pose shape. Its flip test reads like augmentation at evaluation and is the opposite - a deterministic, channel-swapped average that every published COCO number is produced with

forbidden.why: there is no sklearn transformer in this project
the training loader is built with shuffle=True
the validation loader is built with shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard

THE TRAP: every random step in __getitem__ is guarded by self.train, and the validation dataset is constructed with train=False. There is no Compose in this project at all - the augmentation is numpy and cv2

THE SECOND TRAP: the flip test at line 128 is deterministic test-time augmentation whose second pass is un-mirrored and channel-swapped before averaging. It is the published evaluation protocol, not augmentation left on by accident
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is the first statement of the training step
optimizer.step() follows loss.backward() every batch
backward() precedes step()
the only no_grad region is the decorated validate(), which contains no backward()
the running loss accumulates loss.item() * batch size
THE TRAP: JointsMSELoss.forward accumulates `total = total + ...` across 17 joints and RETURNS it - the caller owns the graph and has to, which is the documented vision-05 guard
MultiStepLR is an epoch schedule and scheduler.step() runs in the epoch loop
validate() calls model.eval() before the loop and model.train() on the way out
validate() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator
the PCK is computed on coordinates decoded by an argmax over each joint plane, never on the raw heatmap
there is no softmax and no CrossEntropyLoss in this project
the head is a bare 1x1 Conv2d with no activation and the objective is MSE, which is the correct pairing for a Gaussian heatmap target; there is no BCE anywhere
the model and the criterion are moved with .to(device) and every batch tensor is moved inside both loops
pick_device() checks torch.cuda.is_available()
seed_everything() seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda
there is no split in this project - train.json and val.json are separate files
BasicBlock, Branch, FuseLayer and PoseHighResolutionNet all call super().__init__() first
JointsMSELoss calls super().__init__() first
the branches are wrapped in nn.ModuleList and every block stack in nn.Sequential
the checkpoint saves model.state_dict()
